verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a structured query model for ad hoc analysis: up to six clauses (SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT, HAVING), relational span prefixes, and schemaless querying over fields indexed automatically at ingest. However, queries are built through a GUI Query Builder, and the evidence never shows a written, text-based query language with a full syntax reference, so the 'documented query language' part is only partly covered. Missing for 10: a documented textual query syntax or grammar reference, a full list of operators and functions, and independent hands-on corroboration of query-language depth.

support.subject: As a developer, I can analyze telemetry ad hoc with a documented query language

citations.quote: A query in Honeycomb consists of up to six clauses: SELECT... WHERE... GROUP BY... ORDER BY... LIMIT... HAVING
Construct queries against your telemetry data using Query Builder. Add filters, breakdowns, and calculations manually to build a query.
indexed automatically on every field at ingest, and queryable without a predefined schema.
